title: Increasing Tangential Gain
statement: Increasing the tangential gain will reduce the robot's tendency to veer off course, thereby reducing the risk of collisions.
mechanism: The tangential gain controls the robot's ability to follow the path closely, reducing the likelihood of it deviating and potentially colliding with obstacles.
